admission.justification: The typed stored shape and writer ownership check agree across model and authoring routes. Public writer regressions distinguish a permitted current-task closure from another task’s refused new closure, preserve atomic preview/apply behavior, retain stored closure forms and keep an earlier closed block during later metadata edits.

applicability: Weakness closure authored through the task-bound knowledge writer and validated by the Closure and WeaknessRecord models.
conditions: The closed record names its closing task; when commit is absent the typed Closure requires a reason.
A newly authored closure without a commit names the running leaf, or the task of a non-leaf owner.
An unchanged closed block already stored on a closed record may survive a later task’s unrelated metadata edit.
exclusions: This permits the stored shape and ownership attribution; it does not judge whether the weakness’s cause is removed.
Other writer admission checks still apply. Supplying a commit invokes the separate real-code-commit requirement.

evidence: 261112-BUG-L3-W9-worker.md, item17 acceptance block, checks and Closure census; W9-evidence.tar.gz contains the exact red/green test results and executable commands.

statement: A task may close its own weakness with its task and reason while leaving the code commit absent until closeout.
